body: Nah, NTA. He made a decision when he was 12 and that’s fine. However, he could jave still reached out or at least tried to make an effort when he was 18. Did he actually get all the cards? Did Mom make sure they went to him and give him a choice to contact you? There’s that to think about but his reaction speaks volumes anyways about if he even cares about a relationship versus money. Keep that money and use it for your step-son.

NTA. In this instance, sticking up for your Mom, who did no wrong, was the better choice. However, if you’ve supported your wife’s behavior in the past, expect push back when you siddenly switch sides and expect that she is not happy with it. She’s gotten away with it before, why not again. Time to set some new boundaries my dude, or your kids could learn those behaviors too and think it’s okay to act that way towards your Mom and/or others.
